evidence_basis: Saha, Krishnan and Raghu 2024, Life Sci Alliance (PMID 38056909, PMC10700560): the whole text (.txt, 373 lines, abstract, introduction, results, discussion, methods) read from the PMC open-data bucket copy after a committed pre-registration that stated what had been seen. Figures 2, 3, 4 and 5 and Fig S4 viewed as images; the other figures, the four supplementary tables and the remaining supplementary figures through captions only; the peer review history text searched and read at the reviewers' comments on the neuron arm, inositol and Fig 3F.
